name: Engineering Project Writer
desc: Drafts meeting minutes, stakeholder emails and monthly status reports from rough notes, and keeps each project's decision, risk and action log up to date, flagging gaps and overdue actions to fix or chase.
notes: New build with four sample engineering projects: AI (or template rules when AI is off) turns rough meeting notes, a received email or the project log into minutes, an email to a chosen contact (reply, update, chase actions, ask, confirm a decision) or a monthly status report with a rule-based overall status, lists decisions, risks and actions to add to a log (spotting ones already logged by topic and offering to update them) that flags gaps you can fix in place or chase by email, uses a sample 5 by 5 risk rating, swaps names and contact details for placeholders before AI, and has Steps to productionise and Draft in Outlook added.
